Notes

The Magma Crawler is probably an artificially bred life form. Its sheer mindless aggressiveness compared to the obvious strategic deployment of the Magma Crawler can lead to no other conclusion than that it is a biological weapon which is very difficult to control. It can safely be assumed that it originated in the breeding pens of what the gnomes call 'those below'. If this is the case, it is bred for war and destruction. It is probably deployed to do maximum damage in underground environments. After a Magma Crawler has been set loose, it is usually abandoned. This explains why wandering specimens can be found almost anywhere underground, usually at the end of a path of destruction. As only male Magma Crawlers have been found, it is assumed that the female creatures are retained for breeding purposes, and to prevent the race from spreading excessively. Given the longevity of the Magma Crawlers, this precautionary measure is not overly effective. Some captured specimens survived for dozens of years without showing significant signs of aging. Considering the threat even a single Magma Crawler poses, it is not unusual for a group of them to cause entire cave systems to collapse. It is not yet known if the Magma Crawlers somehow manage to escape the havoc they wreak or if they perish in it.

—Tibia Library
It can be tamed by using a Glow Wine or a Music Box on it.

Behaviour

If you get close, it will attack with melee and use Fire Berserk. Its powerful Death Beam is especially dangerous, dealing around 1200 damage every turn.

A magma crawler attacks from a distance. A magma crawler will retreat at 1 to 191 (0.02% - 3.98%, deep red) health.

History

  • As announced on April 23, 2024, the patch increased its experience from 2,700 to 3,300, reduced probability of melee fighting skill debuff, increased ice sensitivity from 90% to 100%, and reduced probability and duration of invisibility as part of the 2024 Balancing Project.
  • As announced on May 14, 2024, the patch increased experience from 3,300 to 3,900, and reduced melee debuff as part of the 2024 Balancing Project.
  • As announced on March 28, 2024, the patch increased its XP from 3,900 to 4,250, reduced probability of Invisibility, and reduced probability of retargetting as part of the 2024 Balancing Project.
